members.comment: Verified byte participates in CELL DATA and modified-cell savegame output. Bit 0x20 is tested by TESObjectCELL_HasPublicFlag20; bits 0x20|0x40 by TESObjectCELL_HasPublicOrTempPublicState. Bit 0x40 toggles on linked-door lock/unlock, is gated on load by retainActiveFile, and is serialized in CELL state. Probable names: Public (0x20) and TempPublic (0x40), corroborated by Fallout names/masks.
